purpose: Replace the 70-row blanket active-consumer-evidence blocker with explicit source family producer/consumer paths and vNext target/handoff evidence.
rules: Family evidence is valid only for fields of the same persisted aggregate and must include an actual model/repository/service path.
This closes source-consumer accounting, not provider, migration or PostgreSQL acceptance.
Staged vNext targets remain unregistered until the migration integrator promotes them.
Cross-domain handoffs preserve the source evidence but remain completion obligations of the named owner task.
